widgets

A small widget library for Go. Previous releases are listed in the releases page; the rules for contributing are in CONTRIBUTING.md.

Templating

Widgets render with Go templates:

tmpl := template.Must(template.New("w").Parse(`<b>{{ .Name }}</b> {{ range .Items }}{{ . }}{{ end }}`))

The installer reads ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} and falls back to ${HOME}/.config:

export WIDGETS_DIR="${HOME}/.config/widgets"
mkdir -p "${WIDGETS_DIR}" && echo "installed to ${WIDGETS_DIR}"

CI

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: go test ./...

Please ignore the warnings printed by older Go versions; see the earlier discussion in #42.
